UsFundApply.title: Funding application
UsFundApply.subtitle: Apply for SIG/PIG funding, competition support, or mentor/mentee support.

instructions.contest:
Use the following guidelines when writing your application.

Approval: Subject to review by club officers
Support limit: KRW 20,000 per member, or KRW 40,000 if a companion is required
At least 80% of participants must be regular members.
Attach an image showing proof of contest participation.
Examples: ICPC finals, participation confirmation, receipts
instructions.fund:
Use the following guidelines when writing your application.

Approval: Subject to review by club officers
Support limit: KRW 50,000 for SIG; no separate limit for PIG
Approval must be obtained before payment is made.
Specify the SIG or PIG requiring support and how the funds will be used.
instructions.meal:
Use the following guidelines when writing your application.

Approval: Subject to review by club officers
Support limit: KRW 50,000 for SIG; no separate limit for PIG
Approval must be obtained before payment is made.
Specify the SIG or PIG requiring support and the purpose of the gathering.
instructions.pair:
Use the following guidelines when writing your application.

Approval: Subject to review by club officers
Support limit: KRW 20,000 per member
The mentor/mentee pairing must be valid.
